context: Evaluates whether the candidate correctly sets up the Kibo Commerce provider in a Next.js application. Tests knowledge of the CommerceProvider component, the kiboCommerceProvider configuration object, and the useCommerce hook from the @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce package.

checklist.name: Import kiboCommerceProvider
checklist.description: The solution imports kiboCommerceProvider from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce (not a custom object or placeholder).

checklist.name: Import CommerceProvider
checklist.description: The solution imports CommerceProvider from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce or @vercel/commerce and uses it as the wrapping component.

checklist.name: Provider prop passed correctly
checklist.description: kiboCommerceProvider is passed as the provider prop to CommerceProvider.

checklist.name: Children rendered
checklist.description: The wrapper component correctly accepts and renders the children prop inside CommerceProvider.

checklist.name: useCommerce hook exported
checklist.description: A hook using useCommerce from the package is exported and returns the commerce context.
